audit.why: EVEN at 5.5/10 against 53.49% over 1159 games. The difficulty is a range problem, not a damage one: Command: Attack pokes from 815 on a cooldown that falls to 3s at rank 5, while Galio's answer starts at 650 (Justice Punch) and finishes at 275 (Shield of Durand). Existing framing of 'patient early, yours from first item' holds.

audit.whatIsWrong: The early spike is attributed to 'her Dissonance shield'. Command: Dissonance is not a shield.
audit.why: enemyKit W: 'Orianna commands her Ball to release a pulse of energy, dealing magic damage around it. This leaves a field behind that speeds up allies and slows enemies.' 7s flat, 225 range, slow + zone flags, no shield flag. The shield is Command: Protect (E): 'attach to an allied champion, Shielding them... grants additional Armor and Magic Resist', 9s, 1095 range. Two abilities were merged in spikes[0].text, early, whys[0] and wants.foe[1].
audit.corrected: Her sustain spike is Command: Protect (E) — a 9s shield that also gives armour and MR. Command: Dissonance is a 7s damage pulse with a slow field. Level 6 is Command: Shockwave, 110s at rank 1, 410 range. Galio's counter-spikes are Justice Punch (11s) and Hero's Entrance (180s).

audit.whatIsWrong: The page told the reader to 'track the ball position like a second enemy' without saying why it matters mechanically, and never gave a single range or cooldown for the interaction.
audit.why: Command: Shockwave launches enemies toward the Ball, not toward Orianna, from 410 range — so her body position is not the threat indicator, the Ball's is. Command: Dissonance is only 225 range around the Ball, so pulsing it on you requires the Ball to be on top of you, and that is the moment Galio's 275-range taunt reaches. Galio's Q is a projectile (825 range) and her Q is too, at 815 — the poke war is even on range and lost on cooldown, 11s versus 7s falling to 3s.
audit.corrected: Watch the Ball for the R threat; taunt when the Ball comes to 225 range for a Dissonance pulse; do not try to win the Q war on cooldowns.

audit.why: Command: Shockwave 110/95/80, Command: Attack 7/6/5/4/3, Shield of Durand 18/17/16/15/14 are all in the kits, and the 3s rank-5 Q is the number that changes how you play the lane.
